description: This file defines interfaces, structures, and constants for interfacing with the MCP3208 ADC chip. It includes structure definitions for ADC state management, function prototypes for initialization and data acquisition, and macro definitions for hardware-specific pin configurations.

classes.name: McpAdcState
classes.description: Structure holding the state and buffer information for MCP3208 ADC interactions

methods.name: init_adc_mcp3208
methods.description: Initializes the MCP3208 ADC interface with the specified SPI driver and state structure

methods.name: requestAdcValue
methods.description: Requests an ADC conversion for the specified channel

methods.name: requestAdcValueI
methods.description: Interrupt-based request for ADC value on a specified channel

methods.name: adc_in_out
methods.description: Performs ADC input/output operation for the MCP3208

methods.name: getMcp3208adc
methods.description: Retrieves the ADC value of the specified channel
